title: AiScientist skill frontmatter
description: Agent Skills SKILL.md frontmatter plus the AiScientist registry fields carried in `metadata`. Metadata values are strings, as the Agent Skills specification requires; lists are comma-separated.

version.description: Semantic version of the skill itself.

status.description: core: maintained by the registry owners. verified: human-reviewed. community: passed CI, not reviewed.

tested-with.description: Key tool versions of the run the skill was built from.

compute.description: Resources of the tested run, e.g. '16 CPUs, 80 GB RAM, 20 min'.

scheduler.description: Whether an HPC scheduler (Slurm) is needed.

requires-network.description: none: offline. install: only to install software. runtime: the analysis itself calls remote services.

requires-secrets.description: Comma-separated environment variable names the skill needs, or 'none'.
